route.geometry: LP12: Combi bowl at 1:56, wooden-halfpipe spine transfers at 1:49-1:46. Original (absolutcheats): follow the snake run, go through the full pipe, jump off the hip to the top of the halfpipe
LP12: BS wallride + wallie up the wall (1:44-1:43). Original: grind the rail on top of the halfpipe to your right, then jump onto the roof
grind the neon-blue gutter: 'Time 2 Feed the Volcano!!!' (4000) at 1:40; the volcano erupts
drop off; down and left past a neon-blue pole and a neon-pink pole (PS12); original: 'proceed to the Combibowl area but do not enter'
with lots of speed ollie into the middle ('Feed Me!!!', 2000) within ≈ 30 s (remake); PS12 suggests a boneless
Blowin It Out the Hole! opens the Tunnel of Luvin; leave by hitting the clock or skating toward the Neversoft sign (absolutcheats)

skillGates: committed high-speed jump into a hazard-looking crater
collectibles.coupling: timed window after the trigger (≈ 30 s in the remake, PS12; original unknown)
collectibles.failure: miss the crater: wait out or re-trigger (≈ 20 s from spawn in LP12); return from the island via the clock
collectibles.timeFromSpawnS: trigger ≈ 20 (LP12 remake, 1:40); crater entry not shown; original unknown
collectibles.why: A goal-less bonus level still keeps one big secret, opened by a joke-named trigger chain built from its signature verbs (rooftop rail, drop, commit jump)

guidance: The volcano is the tease: visible and smoking from spawn, erupting with plume and rumble once triggered; the gap names spell the instruction
Neon outlines mark grindable edges and island borders
Hidden: the secret island has no visible link to the map (teleport); the remake pickups are there
Gap names double as signposts (Up 2 Combi, Down 2 Tonys Island, Sadlands Up 2 Isle of Tony)
designLogic: A bonus level with no checklist still keeps one secret; the hidden island takes the tape's role
The secret opens through a two-step chain (trigger, timed entry), both named gaps worth 4000 and 2000
A timed window (≈ 30 s in the remake) turns discovery into a planned route
The entry is a commit jump into a hazard-looking crater: the game rewards trust
The level is an anthology of famous skate spots and objects; it rewards with places, not pickups (inference)
Gap ladders teach transfer width and direction (Weak Sauce 50 / normal 800-2000 / Reverse 1000-2000)
Climbing pays more than dropping (Sadlands Up 2 Isle of Tony 1000 vs Isle of Tony 2 Sadlands 300)
Highest values for sustained or rare lines: full-pipe loop 5000, bench series 5000, volcano trigger 4000, wallride-to-platform 2500
Island edges are rails, so falling-off risk is also a line
The remake hangs both new collectibles behind the old secret
remakeChanges: Unlock: all career objectives with all skaters / $150,000 with all characters (original) -> finish every park goal (remake)
Remake adds a VV logo and an alien plushie, both in the volcano's secret area; still no goals
Same volcano chain; remake guide gives a ≈ 30 s window and the hint 'use the side of the channel'; LP12 reaches the roof by wallride + wallie
Gap names: Grassy Gap / Big Fat Grassy Gap -> Portal Gap / Big Fat Portal Gap; Pit O Doom!!!, Southern Snake Gap and Kicker 2 Rail not in PS12; PS12 lists Gutter 2 SD Roof twice (800 and 600)
Look: dark space with purple/pink islands -> neon outlines, nebula sky, palms, BONES and Independent signage
transfer: Timed secret door: grinding a rooftop gutter (or a trick rail locked to a named trick) starts a ≈ 30 s eruption; during it a crater acts as a trampoline/launcher to a floating secret island holding the crystal
Commit jump: make the crater look dangerous and approach it from a platform with a kicker and angled rail so a full-speed ollie (≈ 13.8 m at the charge maximum) clears the rim
Reward the place: float the crystal above the end of a halfpipe on the secret island, visible on arrival but needing a vert air at the far end
Return device: an exit object (clock or sign) that teleports back, so the timed trip never soft-locks
Gap ladder for practice: a snake run with a narrow and a wide transfer at each bend, teaching spine transfers before the crystal route needs one
openQuestions: World-space position of the Chin ramp island and whether VG draws it (its labels sit on the Z3 halfpipe complex)
Eruption window in the original; whether the trigger repeats within a run
Whether falling off an island edge respawns you or ends the run
Original gap points; status of Pit O Doom!!!, Southern Snake Gap and Kicker 2 Rail in the remake
